How do I find all these different values?  There's 2 I can't find unless they're named something different?

1. Rare item odds - I can't find this "1 in xxx" anywhere except for card drops in the AFK window and this is a per hour figure not a numerical figure.
2. Multikill Bonus% - I'm guessing this is the **Multikill per tier** which shows up in the Card Bonuses And Sets?
3. Kills with Multikill - already read that this is the **Kills/hr** which shows up in the AFK window.
4. Drop Rate - already read that this is the **Drop Rarity** which shows up in the Player Info window.

Rare Item Odds are on the monster's card (if you don't have their card, either get one or check the wiki).

Multikill per tier for each world is found at the Deathnote, but it needs your actual multikill. Your Multikill on a mob is found in AFK Info.
You'll also need to unlock Multikill through W3 Construction, if you haven't already.

Note that Multikill only effects the first drop on the card, the other drops are only affected by your actual kills. So Multikill would affect Red Frisbees but not Woodular Circles.
So the sheet needs to calculate your kills without Multikill to work.
